categories.name: Detection and Hunting
categories.description: Security detection, threat hunting, alert triage, and investigation workflows.

categories.name: Logging and Telemetry
categories.description: Security event collection, logging design, telemetry quality, and audit visibility.

categories.name: Offensive Security
categories.description: Authorized adversarial assessment planning and bounded offensive testing; distinct from defensive detection and telemetry workflows.

categories.name: Identity and Access Management
categories.description: Identity inventory, privilege boundary modeling, entitlement analysis, and agent credential governance.

categories.name: Vulnerability Management
categories.description: Vulnerability advisory tracking, SBOM dependency analysis, contextual exposure triage, and risk remediation.

categories.name: Incident Response
categories.description: Post-detection containment and recovery action planning and bounded execution. Detection and Hunting covers discovery and investigation; Identity and Access Management covers entitlement analysis; neither primarily describes coordinated incident actions.
